label: Cyclic dense compressed path matrix density - 15 active 1s returns normalized by causal trailing 2h mean/variance - one recurrent block shared across all steps - lag-0/1/2 59-feature state plus normalization statistics - W256 - Q16 - D64 - O32 - DQ128 DO256 compression - 256k clean - batch 1536

architecture.marketState: m0=GNGLU(concat(feature[t-2:t], trailingMean2h, trailingVariance2h),W); one dense recurrent cell is weight-shared across all 15 horizons with a learned absolute-step embedding
architecture.conditionalReturns: T_s=row-softmax(P_s R_s/sqrt(Q)); J_s=q_s[:,None] times T_s; p_s=sum_D(J_s)
architecture.pathTransition: P_s and J_s are independently compressed by the same dense uncapped GNGLUs at every step to 128 and 256 values; P_s+1=shared-dense-GNGLU(concat(compress(P_s),m_s,compress(J_s),point-state_s))
architecture.matrixApproximation: none; every GNGLU uses dense matrices at expected hidden width floor((input+output)/2)
architecture.outputPoints: ordered market-conditioned unit-interval knots representing trailing-2h-normalized log returns

targetNormalization.population: all completed one-second log returns including exact zeros
targetNormalization.training: each complete future path uses the mean and variance available at its origin
targetNormalization.inference: use the latest complete trailing-window mean and variance for every forecast horizon

density.targetFilter: each start and every path target are exact-nonzero active returns; normalization statistics include zero returns
density.trainingLoss: mean conditional raw-return NLL across 15 steps, evaluated by transforming each target with its causal origin statistics and including the affine Jacobian
